evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Comparative and absolute questions about the same fact therefore measure different things here, and for party issue salience a benchmark built from one cannot speak for the other.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale beneath it.
